"""Versioned B&R injection/holding observations from physical OCR cells."""

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

from raw_contract import canonical_hash, import_raw_package
from raw_page import _line_box
from extract_families.coordinates import project_boxes

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5]
PROFILE = "b_and_r.injection_holding.multi_stage_position_time"
VERSION = "0.6.1"
DEFINITION = "contracts/raw-pages/b-and-r-injection-0.6.1.json"
PAGE_DIR = "scripts/extract_families/b_and_r/injection_holding/multi_stage_position_time"
FILES = tuple(f"{PAGE_DIR}/{name}.py" for name in (
    "raw_observations", "page_identity", "headers", "layout", "holding_layout", "extractor", "observations")) + (
    "scripts/raw_contract.py", "scripts/raw_page.py", "scripts/extract_families/coordinates.py",
    "scripts/extract_families/common.py", "scripts/extract_families/visual_cells.py", DEFINITION)

NUMBER = re.compile(r"^\s*([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(mm/s|mm|bar|%|sec|s)?\s*$", re.I)


def build_bole_injection_package(samples):
    definition = json.loads((ROOT / DEFINITION).read_text())
    expected = {sample["sample_id"]: sample["image_sha256"] for sample in definition["samples"]}
    provided = {sample["manifest"]["sample_id"]: sample["manifest"]["original_sha256"] for sample in samples}
    if provided != expected or len(samples) != len(expected) or len(set(provided.values())) != len(expected):
        raise ValueError("BOLE_INJECTION_FROZEN_SAMPLES_REQUIRED")
    template = json.loads((ROOT / "templates/b_and_r/injection_holding.json").read_text())
    template.update(version=VERSION, extractor="registered_extractor",
                    extractor_id="b_and_r.injection_metering", extractor_version="1",
                    layout_variant=definition["page_identity"]["layout_variant"],
                    page_identity={**definition["page_identity"],
                                   "evidence_sample_ids": [s["sample_id"] for s in definition["samples"]]},
                    sample_ids=[s["sample_id"] for s in definition["samples"]])
    contract = json.loads((ROOT / "contracts/page_observations.v2.schema.json").read_text())
    sources = {path: (ROOT / path).read_text() for path in FILES}
    files = {path: hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() for path, source in sources.items()}
    return dict(package_schema="hmi_raw_page_package.v2", profile_id=PROFILE, version=VERSION,
                template=template, raw_contract=contract, raw_contract_sha256=canonical_hash(contract),
                raw_field_definition=definition, raw_field_definition_sha256=canonical_hash(definition),
                recognizer=dict(id="b_and_r.injection_ocr.v2", version=VERSION, files=files,
                                sources=sources, sha256=canonical_hash(files)), samples=samples)


def bole_injection_package(root=ROOT, version=VERSION):
    package = import_raw_package(json.loads((Path(root) / "templates/raw-packages" / PROFILE / f"{version}.json").read_text()))
    if package["profile_id"] != PROFILE or package["version"] != version:
        raise ValueError("RAW_PACKAGE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    if version == "0.6.0":
        # Historical document export only. Live observations use VERSION and verify live sources.
        return package
    if package["raw_field_definition"] != json.loads((ROOT / DEFINITION).read_text()):
        raise ValueError("RAW_DEFINITION_MISMATCH")
    recognizer = package["recognizer"]
    files = {path: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in FILES}
    if (recognizer.get("id") != "b_and_r.injection_ocr.v2" or recognizer["files"] != files
            or recognizer["sha256"] != canonical_hash(files)
            or {path: hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()
                for path, source in recognizer["sources"].items()} != files):
        raise ValueError("RAW_RECOGNIZER_HASH_MISMATCH")
    return package


def observe_bole_injection(lines, meta, image_sha256, root=ROOT):
    if image_sha256 is not None and not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", image_sha256):
        raise ValueError("IMAGE_HASH_INVALID")
    package = bole_injection_package(root)
    definition = package["raw_field_definition"]
    width, height = meta["screen_size"]
    cells = []
    for line in lines:
        box = _line_box(line)
        cells.append(dict(line=line, text=re.sub(r"\s+", "", line["text"]),
                          x=(box[0] + box[2]) / (2 * width),
                          y=(box[1] + box[3]) / (2 * height), match=NUMBER.fullmatch(line["text"])))

    sections, issues = {}, list(definition["issues"])
    for section, label in (("injection", "射胶"), ("holding", "保压")):
        titles = [c for c in cells if c["text"] == label and .3 < c["x"] < .8 and .3 < c["y"] < .68]
        if len(titles) != 1:
            raise ValueError("BOLE_INJECTION_LAYOUT_UNVERIFIED")
        title = titles[0]
        heads = sorted([c for c in cells if c["text"] in {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5"}
                        and .2 < c["x"] < .95 and 0 < c["y"] - title["y"] < .04], key=lambda c: c["x"])
        ids = [int(c["text"]) for c in heads]
        conflict = len(ids) != len(set(ids))
        if conflict:
            issues.append(dict(code="STAGE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT", section=section))
        if set(ids) != {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}:
            issues.append(dict(code="STAGE_HEADERS_PARTIAL", section=section))
        sections[section] = dict(title=title, heads=heads, conflict=conflict)
    if not sections["injection"]["title"]["y"] < sections["holding"]["title"]["y"]:
        raise ValueError("BOLE_INJECTION_LAYOUT_CONFLICT")

    fields = []
    for spec in definition["fields"]:
        section = spec["section"]
        source_label, header, options, order = None, None, [], spec.get("order")
        conflict = False
        if spec.get("stage"):
            table = sections[section]
            y0 = table["title"]["y"]
            y1 = sections["holding"]["title"]["y"] if section == "injection" else .7
            labels = [c for c in cells if c["text"] in spec["labels"] and c["x"] < .2 and y0 < c["y"] < y1]
            source_label = labels[0] if len(labels) == 1 else None
            matching = [c for c in table["heads"] if int(c["text"]) == spec["stage"]]
            header = matching[0] if len(matching) == 1 else None
            conflict = table["conflict"] or len(labels) > 1
            if source_label and not conflict:
                physical_slot = (min(range(1, 6), key=lambda stage: abs(
                    definition["stage_column_centers"][str(stage)] - header["x"])) if header else spec["stage"])
                order = (table["heads"].index(header) + 1 if header and len(table["heads"]) == 5 else 6 - physical_slot)
                hx = header["x"] if header else definition["stage_column_centers"][str(spec["stage"])]
                options = [c for c in cells if c["match"] and abs(c["y"] - source_label["y"]) < .013
                           and abs(c["x"] - hx) < .075]
        elif spec.get("value_type") != "boolean":
            labels = [c for c in cells if c["text"] in spec["labels"]
                      and spec["label_region"][0] < c["x"] < spec["label_region"][2]
                      and spec["label_region"][1] < c["y"] < spec["label_region"][3]]
            source_label = labels[0] if len(labels) == 1 else None
            conflict = len(labels) > 1
            if source_label:
                if spec.get("direction") == "right":
                    options = [c for c in cells if c["match"] and .04 < c["x"] - source_label["x"] < .25
                               and abs(c["y"] - source_label["y"]) < .018]
                else:
                    options = [c for c in cells if c["match"] and 0 < c["y"] - source_label["y"] < .05
                               and abs(c["x"] - source_label["x"]) < .065]
        source = options[0] if len(options) == 1 and not conflict else None
        unit = source["match"][2] if source else None
        if source and unit is None:
            unit_cells = [c for c in cells if c["text"].lower() in {"%", "bar", "mm", "mm/s", "sec", "s"}
                          and abs(c["y"] - source["y"]) < .015 and c["x"] > source["x"]
                          and (c["x"] - source["x"] < .16 or spec.get("stage"))]
            units = {c["line"]["text"] for c in unit_cells}
            unit = next(iter(units)) if len(units) == 1 else None
        confidence = source["line"].get("conf", source["line"].get("confidence", 0)) if source else None
        reading = ("unsupported" if spec.get("value_type") == "boolean" else
                   "conflict" if conflict or len(options) > 1 else "missing" if source is None else
                   "uncertain" if confidence < .9 or source_label["text"] != spec["label"]
                   or spec.get("stage") and (header is None or header["line"].get("conf", 0) < .9) else "known")
        if unit and ("s" if unit.lower() == "sec" else unit.lower()) != spec["unit"]:
            reading = "conflict"
        field = {key: spec[key] for key in ("screen_field_key", "section", "role", "stage", "segment_id", "time_kind") if key in spec}
        field.update(source="image_recognition", original_label=source_label["line"]["text"] if source_label else None,
                     original_value=float(source["match"][1]) if source else None,
                     original_unit=unit, effective_unit=unit or spec["unit"], state="unknown", reading=reading,
                     order=order, identity_basis="ocr_header" if header else "frozen_field_definition",
                     bbox=_line_box(source["line"]) if source else None, original_bbox=None,
                     text=source["line"]["text"] if source else None, confidence=confidence,
                     reasons=["enable_state_unverified"],
                     template_ref=dict(profile_id=PROFILE, version=VERSION,
                                       sha256=package["raw_field_definition_sha256"],
                                       unit=spec["unit"] if unit is None else None))
        if reading != "known":
            issues.append(dict(code="READING_" + reading.upper(), screen_field_key=spec["screen_field_key"]))
        fields.append(field)
    project_boxes(fields, meta)
    for field in fields:
        if field["original_bbox"] is None:
            field["reasons"].append("source_box_unavailable")
    transform = copy.deepcopy(meta)
    transform.update(rectifier_input_sha256=meta.get("original_sha256"), original_sha256=image_sha256)
    return dict(schema_version="page_observations.v2", source="image_recognition", profile_id=PROFILE,
                page_identity=definition["page_identity"], image_sha256=image_sha256,
                original_size=meta.get("original_size"), coordinate_space="original_percent", transform=transform,
                raw_field_definition_sha256=package["raw_field_definition_sha256"],
                raw_field_definition_version=VERSION, raw_contract_sha256=package["raw_contract_sha256"],
                recognizer=package["recognizer"], package_sha256=canonical_hash(package), fields=fields, issues=issues,
                ocr_evidence=dict(coordinate_space="rectified_pixels", screen_size=meta["screen_size"], lines=lines),
                coverage=dict(status="partial", declared=len(fields), known=sum(f["reading"] == "known" for f in fields)))

"""Identify the B&R page from a visible injection table, without extracting values.

Only OCR text classes and relative box geometry are used. This module does not
read process values, infer active stages, or call the field extractor. Cropping
away the switch region does not invalidate a complete visible table fingerprint.
"""
import re
from statistics import median

from page_identity import line_box as _box
from .headers import section_headers
from extract_families.common import norm_cjk


def assess_page(lines):
    # A complete aligned title chain also identifies the uncropped historical page.
    if section_headers(lines) is not None and any(norm_cjk(l['text']).strip() == '外部信号' for l in lines):
        return dict(matched=True, evidence=['aligned_section_titles_and_external_signal'], missing=[], conflicts=[])
    numeric = re.compile(r'\d+\.\d+')
    tokens = [line for line in lines if _box(line)]
    injections = [line for line in tokens if norm_cjk(line['text']).strip() == '射胶']
    matches = 0
    for title in injections:
        box = _box(title)
        y0 = box[3]
        # Find the four row labels of the injection table; coordinates are relative
        # to the observed title/labels, never to the full photograph dimensions.
        rows = []
        last_y = y0
        for label in ('速度', '压力', '位置', '时间'):
            candidates = [line for line in tokens if norm_cjk(line['text']).strip() == label
                          and _box(line)[1] > last_y and _box(line)[2] < box[0]]
            if not candidates:
                break
            row_label = min(candidates, key=lambda line: _box(line)[1])
            lb = _box(row_label)
            height = lb[3]-lb[1]
            values = [line for line in tokens if numeric.fullmatch(line['text'].strip())
                      and _box(line)[0] > lb[2]
                      and abs((_box(line)[1]+_box(line)[3]-lb[1]-lb[3])/2) <= 1.5*height]
            values.sort(key=lambda line: _box(line)[0], reverse=True)
            if not values:
                break
            centers = [(_box(line)[0]+_box(line)[2])/2 for line in values]
            rows.append((lb, centers))
            last_y = lb[3]
        if len(rows) != 4:
            continue
        speed, pressure, position, actual_time = [row[1] for row in rows]
        if min(map(len, (speed, pressure, position, actual_time))) < 2:
            continue
        steps = [a-b for a, b in zip(speed, speed[1:])]
        pitch = median(steps)
        if min(steps) <= 0 or max(steps) > 1.3*min(steps):
            continue
        # B&R's endpoint and actual-time rows share a half-column stagger.
        if not (sum(any(abs(a-b) < .2*pitch for a in speed) for b in pressure) >= 2
                and sum(any(.25*pitch < a-b < .75*pitch for a in pressure) for b in position) >= 2
                and sum(any(abs(a-b) < .2*pitch for a in position) for b in actual_time) >= 2):
            continue
        units = [norm_cjk(line['text']).strip().lower() for line in tokens
                 if rows[0][0][1] <= _box(line)[1] <= rows[-1][0][3]
                 and _box(line)[0] > max(speed)]
        if '%' in units and 'bar' in units:
            matches += 1
    return dict(matched=matches == 1,
                evidence=['injection_label_order_and_staggered_rows'] if matches else [],
                missing=[] if matches else ['distinctive_injection_table_or_section_chain'],
                conflicts=['multiple_injection_tables'] if matches > 1 else [])


def matches_page(lines):
    return assess_page(lines)['matched']

"""Physical rows of the supported B&R injection/holding page only."""
from statistics import median

from extract_families.visual_cells import tokens_in_cells


def infer_active_stages(rows):
    """Count active stages in this B&R profile's physical three-row table.

    Callers must verify complete cell geometry and printed stage identity first.
    OCR token lists are not physical rows.
    """
    if len(rows) != 3:
        return None
    speed, pressure, third = rows
    n = len(pressure)
    if n < 1 or len(third) != n or len(speed) != n + 1:
        return None
    return n


def physical_rows(rows, boxes, y_lo, y_hi):
    """Read three physical input rows, preserving missing/duplicate OCR cells.

    The first numeric input row anchors the table below its stage header. All
    subsequent physical rows are found from borders, even with no OCR in a row.
    B&R position cells are staggered, so each row has its own lattice.
    """
    tokens = [t for row in rows for t in row]
    matched = [b for b in boxes if y_lo < (b[1]+b[3])/2 < y_hi and any(
        t.get('bbox') and b[0] < (t['bbox'][0]+t['bbox'][2])/2 < b[2]
        and b[1] < (t['bbox'][1]+t['bbox'][3])/2 < b[3] for t in tokens)]
    if not matched:
        return [[], [], []], [[], [], []]
    start = min((b[1]+b[3])/2 for b in matched)
    candidates = sorted([b for b in boxes if start <= (b[1]+b[3])/2 < y_hi],
                        key=lambda b: (b[1]+b[3])/2)
    groups = []
    for box in candidates:
        cy = (box[1]+box[3])/2
        if groups and abs(cy-median((b[1]+b[3])/2 for b in groups[-1])) < (box[3]-box[1])*.5:
            groups[-1].append(box)
        else:
            groups.append([box])
    if len(groups) != 3:
        return [[], [], []], [[], [], []]
    aligned, evidence = [], []
    for group in groups:
        cells = sorted(group, reverse=True)
        widths = [b[2]-b[0] for b in cells]
        centers = [(b[0]+b[2])/2 for b in cells]
        steps = [a-b for a,b in zip(centers, centers[1:])]
        regular = (len(cells) >= 1 and max(widths) < 1.3*min(widths)
                   and all(.85*median(widths) < step < 1.3*median(widths) for step in steps))
        if not regular:
            return [[], [], []], [[], [], []]
        aligned.append(tokens_in_cells(tokens, cells))
        evidence.append(cells)
    # Pressure aligns with speed; the position row may be half a cell staggered.
    # Reject a shifted/truncated row even when its cell count happens to fit.
    speed, pressure, third = evidence
    width = median(b[2]-b[0] for b in speed)
    for row, tolerance in ((pressure, .25), (third, .65)):
        offsets = [(b[0]+b[2]-s[0]-s[2])/2 for b, s in zip(row, speed)]
        if (not offsets or any(abs(delta) > tolerance*width for delta in offsets)
                or max(offsets)-min(offsets) > .2*width):
            return [[], [], []], [[], [], []]
    return aligned, evidence


def stage_identity(tokens, rows, title_y, size, reference=None):
    """Verify right-to-left numbering against printed headers or sibling table.

    The sibling table must already have verified stage identity. This guards a
    cropped/missing rightmost cell from silently becoming stage 1.
    """
    if not rows or not rows[0]:
        return False
    w, h = size
    cells = rows[0]
    header_bottom = min(b[1] for b in cells)
    headers = [t for t in tokens if t['text'].strip() in {'1','2','3','4','5'}
               and t.get('conf', 0) >= .8 and title_y*h < t['y']*h < header_bottom]
    verified = []
    for token in headers:
        x = token['x']*w
        matches = [index+1 for index,b in enumerate(cells)
                   if abs(x-(b[0]+b[2])/2) < .4*(b[2]-b[0])]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            if matches[0] != int(token['text']):
                return False
            verified.append(matches[0])
    if verified:
        return len(verified) == len(set(verified))
    if reference:
        right = cells[0]
        return abs(right[0]+right[2]-reference[0]-reference[2])/2 < .35*(right[2]-right[0])
    return False

"""Logical holding grid for the supported B&R page, after page routing.

Build row/column axes from coordinates first, then associate observations with
their logical intersections. Predictions never become observed rectangles.
This module assigns spatial identities, never parses or corrects process values.
"""
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
import re
from statistics import median

from .layout import stage_identity

ROWS = ('velocity', 'pressure', 'time')
LABELS = {'速度': 'velocity', '压力': 'pressure', '时间': 'time'}
NUMBER = re.compile(r'(?:\d+\.\d+|\d{3,})')


@dataclass
class Cell:
    section: str
    row_key: str
    stage_id: int
    predicted_bbox: list
    observed_border_ids: list = field(default_factory=list)
    ocr_token_ids: list = field(default_factory=list)
    raw_reading: list = field(default_factory=list)
    ocr_confidences: list = field(default_factory=list)
    stage_identity_verified: bool = False
    mapping_status: str = 'needs_review'
    evidence: list = field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: list = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class LayoutResult:
    profile_id: str = 'b_and_r.injection_holding.multi_stage_position_time'
    section: str = 'holding'
    cells: list = field(default_factory=list)
    column_centers: list = field(default_factory=list)
    column_axis_evidence: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    row_axes: list = field(default_factory=list)
    observed_borders: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    ocr_observations: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    stage_header_ids: list = field(default_factory=list)
    state_evidence: list = field(default_factory=list)
    conflicts: list = field(default_factory=list)
    stage_identity_verified: bool = False
    active_stages: int | None = None


def _center(box):
    return (box[0]+box[2])/2, (box[1]+box[3])/2


def _groups(items, coordinate, tolerance):
    groups = []
    for item in sorted(items, key=coordinate):
        if groups and abs(coordinate(item)-median(coordinate(i) for i in groups[-1])) < tolerance:
            groups[-1].append(item)
        else:
            groups.append([item])
    return groups


def _slope(points):
    xs, ys = zip(*points)
    mx, my = sum(xs)/len(xs), sum(ys)/len(ys)
    denominator = sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
    return sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x, y in points)/denominator if denominator else 0.


def _ink_present(gray, box):
    if gray is None:
        return False
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = map(round, box)
    patch = gray[max(0, y0):min(gray.shape[0], y1), max(0, x0):min(gray.shape[1], x1)]
    return bool(patch.size and patch.max() > patch.min())


def build_holding_layout(tokens, boxes, title_y, end_y, size, gray, reference=None):
    """Return per-cell raw evidence and verified mappings, including missing cells.

    title_y/end_y are section-local limits in image pixels. The caller supplies
    only an independently verified sibling's stage-one rectangle as reference.
    Row keys follow this profile's three ordered rows, checked against any labels.
    Column identities need consistent printed numbering or the sibling reference.
    """
    result = LayoutResult()
    indexed = [(f'ocr-{i}', t) for i, t in enumerate(tokens)]
    local = [(tid, t) for tid, t in indexed if t.get('bbox')
             and title_y < _center(t['bbox'])[1] < end_y]
    result.ocr_observations = {tid: dict(text=t['text'], confidence=t.get('conf', 0), bbox=t['bbox'],
                                       line_index=t.get('line_index'))
                               for tid, t in local}
    labels = [(tid, t) for tid, t in local if t['text'].strip() in LABELS]
    text_height = median(t['bbox'][3]-t['bbox'][1] for _, t in local) if local else 0
    if not text_height:
        result.conflicts.append('NO_SECTION_OBSERVATIONS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    borders = [(f'border-{i}', b) for i, b in enumerate(boxes)
               if title_y+1.5*text_height < _center(b)[1] < end_y]
    left = (max(t['bbox'][2] for _, t in labels)+text_height if labels
            else min((b[0] for _, b in borders), default=size[0]))
    numbers = [(tid, t) for tid, t in local if NUMBER.fullmatch(t['text'].strip())
               and _center(t['bbox'])[0] > left
               and _center(t['bbox'])[1] > title_y+1.5*text_height]
    if not numbers and not borders:
        result.conflicts.append('NO_ROW_COLUMN_OBSERVATIONS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    # Fit shared local skew without using any numeric value or enabled state.
    numeric_rows = _groups(numbers, lambda item: _center(item[1]['bbox'])[1], text_height*1.2)
    slopes = [_slope([_center(t['bbox']) for _, t in row]) for row in numeric_rows if len(row) >= 2]
    if not numbers:
        typical_height = median(b[3]-b[1] for _, b in borders)
        borders = [(bid, b) for bid, b in borders if b[3]-b[1] >= typical_height*.8]
    if not slopes and borders:
        border_rows = _groups(borders, lambda item: _center(item[1])[1],
                              median(b[3]-b[1] for _, b in borders)*.5)
        slopes = [_slope([_center(b) for _, b in row]) for row in border_rows if len(row) >= 2]
    slope = median(slopes) if slopes else 0.
    first_row = (min(_center(t['bbox'])[1]-slope*_center(t['bbox'])[0] for _, t in numbers+labels)
                 if numbers else min(_center(b)[1]-slope*_center(b)[0] for _, b in borders))
    # Stage-heading rectangles are observations too, but lie above the value
    # rows. Select by the local text axes, not by a screen-relative y window.
    borders = [(bid, b) for bid, b in borders
               if _center(b)[1]-slope*_center(b)[0] >= first_row-text_height*.5]
    observations = [dict(kind='ocr', id=tid, box=t['bbox'], token=t) for tid, t in numbers]
    observations += [dict(kind='border', id=bid, box=b) for bid, b in borders if b[0] >= left]
    observations += [dict(kind='label', id=tid, box=t['bbox'], row=LABELS[t['text'].strip()])
                     for tid, t in labels]
    projected = lambda item: _center(item['box'])[1]-slope*_center(item['box'])[0]
    height = median(b[3]-b[1] for _, b in borders) if borders else text_height*2
    groups = _groups(observations, projected, max(text_height*1.2, height*.45))
    if len(groups) != 3:
        result.conflicts.append('ROW_AXIS_AMBIGUOUS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    for key, group in zip(ROWS, groups):
        conflicts = [o['id'] for o in group if o['kind'] == 'label' and o['row'] != key]
        result.row_axes.append(dict(row_key=key, slope=slope,
            intercept=median(projected(o) for o in group),
            label_ids=[o['id'] for o in group if o['kind'] == 'label'], conflicts=conflicts))
    speed = [o for o in groups[0] if o['kind'] != 'label']
    widths = [o['box'][2]-o['box'][0] for o in speed if o['kind'] == 'border']
    xs = sorted({_center(o['box'])[0] for o in speed}, reverse=True)
    if len(xs) < 2:
        result.conflicts.append('COLUMN_AXIS_AMBIGUOUS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    merge = median(widths)*.25 if widths else text_height
    columns = _groups(speed, lambda o: -_center(o['box'])[0], merge)
    centers = [median(_center(o['box'])[0] for o in group) for group in columns]
    if len(centers) < 2:
        result.conflicts.append('COLUMN_AXIS_AMBIGUOUS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    pitch = min(a-b for a, b in zip(centers, centers[1:]))
    width = median(widths) if widths else pitch*.9
    if not .85*width < pitch < 1.3*width:
        result.conflicts.append('IRREGULAR_COLUMN_AXIS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    positions = [round((centers[0]-x)/pitch) for x in centers]
    if (any(abs(centers[0]-i*pitch-x) > .2*pitch for i, x in zip(positions, centers))
            or positions[-1] >= 5):
        result.conflicts.append('IRREGULAR_COLUMN_AXIS')
        return result, [[], [], []]
    result.column_centers = [centers[0]-i*pitch for i in range(positions[-1]+1)]
    predicted_speed = [[round(x-width/2), round(result.row_axes[0]['intercept']+slope*x-height/2),
                        round(x+width/2), round(result.row_axes[0]['intercept']+slope*x+height/2)]
                       for x in result.column_centers]
    result.stage_identity_verified = stage_identity(tokens, [predicted_speed], title_y/size[1], size, reference)
    if reference is not None and abs(result.column_centers[0]-_center(reference)[0]) >= .35*width:
        result.stage_identity_verified = False
        result.conflicts.append('SIBLING_COLUMN_CONFLICT')
    result.stage_header_ids = [tid for tid, t in local if t['text'].strip() in {'1', '2', '3', '4', '5'}
                              and t.get('conf', 0) >= .8
                              and _center(t['bbox'])[1] < min(b[1] for b in predicted_speed)]
    result.column_axis_evidence = dict(stage_header_ids=result.stage_header_ids,
                                       reference_bbox=reference,
                                       reference_source='verified_injection_stage_one' if reference else None,
                                       source_ids=[o['id'] for o in speed])
    if not result.stage_identity_verified:
        result.conflicts.append('STAGE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT_OR_MISSING')
    n = len(result.column_centers)-1
    mapped_rows = []
    for key, group, axis in zip(ROWS, groups, result.row_axes):
        count = n+1 if key == 'velocity' else n
        mapped = [None]*count
        cells = []
        for i, x in enumerate(result.column_centers[:count]):
            cy = axis['intercept']+slope*x
            cell = Cell('holding', key, i+1,
                        [round(x-width/2), round(cy-height/2), round(x+width/2), round(cy+height/2)],
                        stage_identity_verified=result.stage_identity_verified)
            cell.evidence = ['ordered_row_axis', 'regular_column_axis']+axis['label_ids']
            cell.evidence += result.stage_header_ids
            if reference is not None:
                cell.evidence.append('verified_sibling_stage_one')
            if axis['conflicts']:
                cell.reasons.append('ROW_LABEL_CONFLICT')
            cells.append(cell)
        assigned = {o['id'] for o in group if o['kind'] == 'ocr'}
        extra_text = [dict(kind='ocr', id=tid, box=t['bbox'], token=t) for tid, t in local
                      if tid not in assigned and any(
                          c.predicted_bbox[0] < _center(t['bbox'])[0] < c.predicted_bbox[2]
                          and c.predicted_bbox[1] < _center(t['bbox'])[1] < c.predicted_bbox[3]
                          for c in cells)]
        for observation in [o for o in group if o['kind'] != 'label']+extra_text:
            x, _ = _center(observation['box'])
            indexes = [i for i, cx in enumerate(result.column_centers[:count]) if abs(cx-x) < .25*pitch]
            if len(indexes) != 1:
                # A visible off-axis box is contrary evidence; never silently skip it.
                for cell in cells:
                    cell.reasons.append('OFF_AXIS_'+observation['kind'].upper())
                continue
            cell = cells[indexes[0]]
            if observation['kind'] == 'border':
                cell.observed_border_ids.append(observation['id'])
                result.observed_borders[observation['id']] = observation['box']
            else:
                t = observation['token']
                cell.ocr_token_ids.append(observation['id'])
                cell.raw_reading.append(t['text'])
                cell.ocr_confidences.append(t.get('conf', 0))
        for i, cell in enumerate(cells):
            if len(cell.ocr_token_ids) != 1:
                cell.reasons.append('OCR_MISSING' if not cell.ocr_token_ids else 'OCR_AMBIGUOUS')
            if len(cell.observed_border_ids) > 1:
                cell.reasons.append('BORDER_AMBIGUOUS')
            if not result.stage_identity_verified:
                cell.reasons.append('STAGE_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED')
            hits = [o for o in group+extra_text if o['kind'] == 'ocr' and o['id'] in cell.ocr_token_ids]
            if len(hits) == 1 and not _ink_present(gray, hits[0]['box']):
                cell.reasons.append('OCR_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_MISSING')
            if not cell.reasons:
                cell.mapping_status = 'verified'
                mapped[i] = hits[0]['token']
            result.cells.append(cell)
        mapped_rows.append(mapped)
    # Count belongs to page state, not routing. Measured row extents can be
    # borders or jointly labeled OCR coordinates; predicted rectangles alone
    # cannot establish enabled stages. Numeric values are never inspected.
    endpoint = any(c.row_key != 'velocity' and c.stage_id == n and c.observed_border_ids
                   and not any(reason.startswith(('OFF_AXIS', 'ROW_LABEL')) for reason in c.reasons)
                   for c in result.cells)
    joint_extents = all(axis['label_ids'] and any(
        c.row_key == axis['row_key'] and c.stage_id == n and c.mapping_status == 'verified'
        for c in result.cells) for axis in result.row_axes[1:])
    if endpoint:
        result.state_evidence.append('observed_lower_row_extent')
    if joint_extents:
        result.state_evidence.append('two_labeled_ocr_row_extents')
    if result.stage_identity_verified and (endpoint or joint_extents) and not any(a['conflicts'] for a in result.row_axes):
        result.active_stages = n
    else:
        result.conflicts.append('ACTIVE_STAGE_EXTENT_UNVERIFIED')
    return result, mapped_rows


def layout_evidence(layout):
    return asdict(layout)

"""Expose the B&R injection/holding physical page to the review contract."""

import cv2

from extract_families.visual_cells import cell_glyph_evidence


ROWS = {
    "injection.speed": "injection_velocity_pct",
    "injection.pressure": "injection_pressure_bar",
    "injection.end": "injection_position_mm",
    "holding.speed": "holding_velocity_pct",
    "holding.pressure": "holding_pressure_bar",
    "holding.time": "holding_time_s",
}

SCALARS = {
    "vp.position": "vp_switch_position_mm",
    "vp.switch.time": "vp_switch_time_s",
}


def _visual_active_count(cells: list, gray) -> int | None:
    """B&R semantics: one verified dark-to-gray boundary on physical cells.

    OCR confidence and token count cannot establish cell visibility. The same
    physical image yields the same state evidence even when OCR misses text.
    """
    if gray is None or not cells:
        return None
    evidence = [cell_glyph_evidence(gray, box) for box in cells]
    if any(item is None or item["contrast"] is None for item in evidence):
        return None
    contrasts = [item["contrast"] for item in evidence]
    candidates = [split for split in range(1, len(cells))
                  if min(contrasts[:split]) - max(contrasts[split:]) >= 25
                  and min(contrasts[:split]) >= 1.2 * max(contrasts[split:])]
    return candidates[0] if len(candidates) == 1 else None


def b_and_r_page_observations(fields: dict, template: dict, source_tokens: dict | None = None,
                              *, stage_cells: dict | None = None,
                              layout_counts: dict | None = None,
                              raw_values: dict | None = None, image_path=None) -> dict:
    candidate = template["business_profile_candidate"]
    aliases = candidate["possible_names"]
    units = candidate["field_units"]
    observations = []
    last_injection = fields.get("injection_stages")
    source_tokens = source_tokens or {}
    gray = cv2.imread(str(image_path), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) if image_path is not None else None
    visual_counts = {section: count for section, cells in (stage_cells or {}).items()
                     if (count := _visual_active_count(cells, gray)) is not None
                     and count == fields.get(f"{section}_stages")}
    layout_counts = layout_counts or {}

    def add(field_id: str, alias_id: str, value, stage: int | None, token: dict | None):
        if value is None:
            return
        final_display = field_id == f"injection.end.{last_injection}"
        section = field_id.split(".")[0]
        box = token.get("bbox") if token else None
        count = layout_counts.get(section)
        verified = stage is not None and count is not None and stage <= count
        disabled = stage is not None and count is not None and stage > count
        state = "enabled" if verified else "disabled" if disabled else "unknown"
        observations.append(dict(
            label=aliases[alias_id][0].replace("{n}", str(stage)), value=value,
            unit=units[alias_id], role="unknown" if final_display else "setting",
            section=section if section in {"injection", "holding"} else "scalar",
            stage=stage, state=state,
            state_basis="verified_physical_layout" if stage and count is not None else None,
            text=token["text"] if token else str(value),
            confidence=token.get("conf", 0.0) if token else 0.0,
            bbox=box, original_bbox=None,
            line_indexes=[token["line_index"]] if token and "line_index" in token else [], reasons=(["source_box_unavailable"] if box is None else []) +
            (["stage_state_unverified"] if stage and state == "unknown" else []) +
            (["low_confidence"] if not token or token.get("conf", 0) < .8 else []),
        ))

    for prefix, source in ROWS.items():
        for number, value in enumerate((raw_values or fields).get(source) or [], 1):
            tokens = source_tokens.get(source) or []
            add(f"{prefix}.{number}", f"{prefix}.{{n}}", value, number,
                tokens[number - 1] if number <= len(tokens) else None)
    for field_id, source in SCALARS.items():
        add(field_id, field_id, fields.get(source), None, source_tokens.get(source))
    return dict(version="1.0", profile_id=template["profile_id"],
                coordinate_space="original_percent", fields=observations,
                stage_counts={}, visual_stage_counts={k: v for k, v in visual_counts.items() if k == "injection"})

"""Shared geometric projection; coordinates retain the original-percent contract."""

def project_boxes(observations, meta):
    """用矫正时的屏幕四角将字段框投回原图百分比坐标；元数据缺失则保持未定位。"""
    if not meta.get('original_size') or not meta.get('screen_quad'):
        return
    import cv2
    import numpy as np
    from quality import order_points
    w, h = meta['screen_size']
    ow, oh = meta['original_size']
    src = np.array([[0, 0], [w-1, 0], [w-1, h-1], [0, h-1]], dtype=np.float32)
    matrix = cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(src, order_points(np.array(meta['screen_quad'], dtype=np.float32)))
    for observation in observations:
        if observation['bbox'] is None:
            continue
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = observation['bbox']
        corners = np.array([[[x1, y1], [x2, y1], [x2, y2], [x1, y2]]], dtype=np.float32)
        points = cv2.perspectiveTransform(corners, matrix)[0]
        box = [float(points[:, 0].min()/ow*100), float(points[:, 1].min()/oh*100),
               float(points[:, 0].max()/ow*100), float(points[:, 1].max()/oh*100)]
        if all(0 <= value <= 100 for value in box) and box[0] < box[2] and box[1] < box[3]:
            observation['original_bbox'] = box

"""Brand-neutral bordered-cell geometry and image-only glyph evidence.

Input boxes and output boxes use image pixels. No stage or enable semantics live here.
Supported cells have closed, near-horizontal rectangular borders after rectification.
"""
import cv2
import numpy as np

from .common import bbox_grayscale_contrast


def bordered_cells(gray):
    if gray is None or gray.ndim != 2:
        return []
    h, w = gray.shape
    binary = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C,
                                   cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV, 31, 7)
    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(binary, cv2.RETR_LIST, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    boxes = []
    for contour in contours:
        x, y, width, height = cv2.boundingRect(contour)
        if (.06*w < width < .25*w and .012*h < height < .06*h
                and 2 < width/height < 5 and cv2.contourArea(contour) > .8*width*height):
            boxes.append([x, y, x+width, y+height])
    # Inner and outer border contours describe the same physical cell.
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b: (b[2]-b[0])*(b[3]-b[1]))
    result = []
    for box in boxes:
        if not any(abs(box[0]+box[2]-b[0]-b[2])/2 < .02*w
                   and abs(box[1]+box[3]-b[1]-b[3])/2 < .01*h for b in result):
            result.append(box)
    return result


def cell_glyph_evidence(gray, box):
    """Find central text components without OCR, excluding the cell border.

    Return no evidence when ink cannot be separated from the background. This is
    a contrast measurement, not an enabled/disabled classifier.
    """
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    dx, dy = x1-x0, y1-y0
    left, top = int(x0+.2*dx), int(y0+.2*dy)
    patch = gray[top:int(y1-.2*dy), left:int(x1-.2*dx)]
    if patch.size == 0 or np.ptp(patch) == 0:
        return None
    _, ink = cv2.threshold(patch, 0, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV+cv2.THRESH_OTSU)
    _, _, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(ink)
    parts = [s for s in stats[1:] if s[4] >= max(3, patch.size*.003)
             and s[3] >= patch.shape[0]*.25]
    if not parts:
        return None
    glyph = [left+min(s[0] for s in parts), top+min(s[1] for s in parts),
             left+max(s[0]+s[2] for s in parts), top+max(s[1]+s[3] for s in parts)]
    glyph = [int(value) for value in glyph]
    contrast = bbox_grayscale_contrast(gray, glyph)
    return dict(bbox=box, glyph_bbox=glyph, contrast=contrast)


def tokens_in_cells(tokens, cells):
    """Keep empty and ambiguous cells explicit, without compacting later values."""
    result = []
    for x0, y0, x1, y1 in cells:
        hits = [t for t in tokens if t.get('bbox') is not None
                and x0 < (t['bbox'][0]+t['bbox'][2])/2 < x1
                and y0 < (t['bbox'][1]+t['bbox'][3])/2 < y1]
        result.append(hits[0] if len(hits) == 1 else None)
    return result
